Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1418
Claimant:
Linda Arnold
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
August 20, 2024
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while
stopped at a traffic signal. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further conatct is being routed through the
attorney's office.
September 21, 2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the policy was in force at the time of loss. Police report reflects the
claimant was present in the vehicle, and the responding officer's notes match the parties' statements on the general
sequence of events.
November 19, 2024
Reviewed scene and vehicle photographs. Damage to the rear of the claimant's vehicle is largely consistent with the
described impact, though a few old scratches on the bumper area may predate this crash and will need to be
separated out during appraisal.
November 21, 2024
Spoke with a neighbor who reported seeing the vehicle with rear damage several weeks before the claimed date of
loss. The statement is unverified and has been noted for follow-up, since no independent witness has come forward
for this collision.
November 27, 2024
Claimant's account has remained the same across every conversation, including the initial call and the recorded
statement given through counsel. Medical records show whiplash diagnosis, with no prior injury to the neck or upper
back found in the history provided so far.
January 12, 2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of soft-tissue injury. It is not yet clear whether
all of the treatment is related to this crash, and a records review has been requested to address causation.
February 2, 2025
File remains open pending receipt of complete medical records, the appraisal with the scratch allocation, and the
outcome of the neighbor follow-up. Next review is scheduled once counsel responds to the records request.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
